exercises.prompt: Połącz zwroty z tłumaczeniem.
answer: I wish to express my concern...|Pragnę wyrazić zaniepokojenie...
I am writing in response to...|Piszę w odpowiedzi na...
I would urge you to...|Usilnie proszę o...

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is firm but polite?
exercises.answer: I would urge the council to reconsider this decision.

exercises.prompt: ___ you require further information, please do not hesitate to contact me.
I am writing in ___ to your article of 5 March. (odpowiedzi)
I wish to express my ___ regarding the closure of the library. (zaniepokojenie)
Ułóż początek listu.
answer: I am writing in response to your article on the planned closure of Riverside Library.
I wish to express my deep concern about this decision.
exercises.explanation: Powitanie, cel, stanowisko. Potoczne zakończenie nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: I am writing with regard of the proposed changes.
Ufam, że potraktują Państwo tę sprawę priorytetowo.
exercises.answer: I trust that you will give this matter your urgent attention.
accept: I trust you will give this matter your urgent attention.
I trust that you will treat this matter as a priority.
I trust you will treat this matter as a priority.

exercises.prompt:
Przepisz z inwersją, zacznij od „Were the council”.
If the council closed the library, many residents would suffer.
exercises.answer: Were the council to close the library, many residents would suffer.

exercises.prompt: You start with "Dear Councillor Nowak". How do you end?
Połącz słowa z tłumaczeniem.
Which sentence uses nominalisation?
exercises.answer: The closure of the library would affect hundreds of families.
distractors: If they close the library, families will suffer.

exercises.prompt: I would be grateful ___ you could reply by the end of the month.
Not ___ is the plan expensive, but it is also unnecessary.
exercises.meaning: Plan jest nie tylko drogi, ale też niepotrzebny.

exercises.prompt: I look forward to your ___. (odpowiedzi)
Ułóż akapit z propozycją.
answer: Rather than closing the library, the council could consider sharing the building with a local café.
Such an arrangement would reduce costs while keeping the service open.
Similar schemes have proved successful in several nearby towns.
exercises.explanation: Propozycja, korzyść, przykład. Potoczny zwrot nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: Should you required further details, please contact me.
Usilnie proszę radę o ponowne rozważenie tej decyzji.
exercises.answer: I would urge the council to reconsider this decision.
accept: I urge the council to reconsider this decision.
I would strongly urge the council to reconsider this decision.

exercises.prompt:
Połącz zdania z „Not only ... but also”.
The plan is costly. It is unpopular.
exercises.answer: Not only is the plan costly, but it is also unpopular.
accept: Not only is the plan costly but it is also unpopular.
Not only is the plan costly, it is also unpopular.

exercises.prompt: Which ending is suitable?
exercises.answer: I look forward to your response.

exercises.prompt: Połącz powitanie z zakończeniem.
Which sentence presents evidence?
exercises.answer: According to the council's own figures, visitor numbers have risen by 15%.
distractors: Everyone knows the library is great.

exercises.prompt: I am ___ that the decision was taken without consulting residents.
The decision was taken without ___ residents. (konsultacji z)
I trust that you will give this matter your ___ attention. (pilną)
Ułóż zakończenie listu.
answer: I trust that you will give this matter your urgent attention.
I look forward to your response.
exercises.explanation: Formułki, zakończenie, podpis. Nieformalne pożegnanie nie pasuje.

exercises.prompt: I am concerning about the lack of public consultation.
Decyzję podjęto bez konsultacji z mieszkańcami.
exercises.answer: The decision was taken without consulting residents.
accept: The decision was made without consulting residents.
The decision was taken without consulting the residents.
The decision was made without consulting the residents.

I'm really unhappy about the new parking fees.
exercises.answer: I wish to express my dissatisfaction with the new parking fees.
accept: I wish to express my concern about the new parking fees.
I wish to express my concern regarding the new parking fees.
I wish to express my dissatisfaction regarding the new parking fees.
